tools.name: write_formula
tools.description: Write Excel formulas to cells (=SUM, =INDEX, =IF etc). Example: write_formula('Sheet1','C2',[['=B2*1.1']]). Prefer fill_range to copy a formula down instead of sending thousands of formula strings.

tools.name: fill_range
tools.description: AutoFill from a source range down (default) or right using Excel, like dragging the fill handle. Omit destination to fill to the sheet used range. fillType: default|copy|series|formats|values (formulas aliases to copy). Do not read the column into the model and write_to_sheet it back.

range.description: Source cells, e.g. C2 or C2:C2

destination.description: Must include the source. Omit to fill to used last row/col.
